comparison.method: Identical independent observation oracle applied separately to retained S0 actual-paint traces and new S1 traces; each file is one uninterrupted forward run after seek. Does not trust S1 floorStatus to detect errors. Wall time, not native-tick truth; totals across intentionally repeated runs, not whole-match prevalence.

performance.drawScope: Quantiles of production rolling-120-draw p95 snapshots across full R1/R2; observer overhead present. Not raw independent draw sample quantiles or an FPS claim.
performance.utilityPeakScope: Supplemental read-only OS historical-peak snapshots during final full R1/R2 and lifecycle. Initial import peak separately captured by Electron runner. No simultaneous-total-memory or uninstrumented memory-delta claim. Supplemental lifecycle run also samples OS historical peaks after import and before closing the reimported worker.

imageCache.scope: Actual two decoded 1024x1024 images / compressed bytes; RGBA estimate excludes browser decoder/GPU overhead and is not a measured OS memory delta. One extra layer vs previous one-image owner; lifecycle disposal verified.

limitations: No real Vertigo fixture: geometry/synthetic threshold tests only
No full 21-round per-display-frame playthrough, all-player permutations, disconnect demo, installed build, physical multi-monitor DPI or independent manual walkthrough
Known parser <=5s replay-query budget remains independently tracked; S1 does not optimize or remeasure native query timing
Normal empty floors, native missing rows and cold seeks without reliable history intentionally remain blank
Original map resource/DEM-version match remains unconfirmed; no topology/LOS claim
